cases.decision_reason: The shared wrapper preserved the thin gate's allow-apply outcome while keeping delegated apply disabled by contract.
notes: The pass case proves the shared Python wrapper can surface a wrapper-owned pass result without claiming publish ownership.
The wrapper remains read-only even when the underlying thin gate family is eligible for delegated continuation in other contexts.

cases.decision_reason: Create-specific front-half preflight found invalid prerequisites before local branch materialization.
notes: The shared wrapper stop case proves that pr-create-preflight stays planning-only even when routed through the wrapper layer.
The retained wrapper result keeps the stop boundary explicit instead of flattening later create stages into one wrapper-owned outcome.

cases.decision_reason: The local operator-facing surface preserved the shared wrapper pass semantics and wrote wrapper-owned artifacts under one operator root.
notes: The pass case proves the PowerShell surface can derive wrapper-owned output paths without widening into live delegated apply.
The operator-facing surface preserves trigger_surface=local-operator-facing so downstream evidence can distinguish it from the shared wrapper's direct CLI use.

cases.decision_reason: The local operator-facing surface preserved the shared wrapper stop semantics and retained the family-plan/front-half evidence under the same operator root.
notes: The stop case proves the operator-facing surface keeps pr-create-preflight on the planning-only side of the boundary.
The retained artifact root includes wrapper-owned outputs plus the family-plan/front-half preflight evidence needed to explain the stop.

adoption_decision.reason: The repo now has representative shared-wrapper and local-operator-facing evidence, but it does not yet have a dedicated manual GitHub Actions wrapper surface over the shared entrypoint.
required_before_broader_ci: Add one manual workflow_dispatch wrapper that reuses the shared read-only wrapper entrypoint and publishes the same wrapper-owned artifacts.
Keep the GitHub-side surface secondary-enforcement-only and read-only by default, matching S0E-7A wording.
Retain at least one pass sample and one stop sample from the workflow_dispatch surface before considering broader CI widening.

boundary_conclusions: The same read-only wrapper result vocabulary (pass / stop / error) now spans both direct shared-wrapper invocation and the local operator-facing surface.
pr-create-preflight remains planning-only through both wrapper layers, with the stop boundary still fixed at S4-local-branch-materialization.
Broader CI adoption remains a follow-up surface decision, not an implicit consequence of finishing the local wrapper adoption slice.
